source: client brief — HEATPROOF HP-700T high-temperature steel billet identification (800°C)

title.en: HEATPROOF HP-700T High-Temperature Steel Billet Identification
title.zh: HEATPROOF HP-700T 钢坯高温识别方案

subtitle.en: Direct-apply barcode labeling for 800°C hot-rolled billets — one code, end-to-end traceability.
subtitle.zh: 在 800°C 热轧钢坯上直贴条码标识 —— 一码到底，全流程追溯。

seo_desc.en: How HEATPROOF HP-700T replaces manual paint marking on 800°C hot-rolled steel billets with robot-applied, heat-activated barcode labels for automated, one-code traceability from before rolling through inventory to shipment.
seo_desc.zh: HEATPROOF HP-700T 如何在 800°C 热轧钢坯上以机器人直贴、热激活的条码标签替代人工喷涂，实现从轧制前到库存、出货的自动化一码追溯。

en.label: Application stages
en.value: Before rolling, inventory management, and shipment

zh.label: 应用环节
zh.value: 轧制前、库存管理与出货

en: The site currently relies on manually applied paint markings to identify steel billets. At temperatures up to 800°C, this method cannot support continuous automated identification and creates several operational problems.

Paint markings may disappear as the surface oxide scale flakes off, causing billet identification to be lost before rolling. Labels must then be applied manually after cooling, increasing the risk of incorrect labeling and material mix-ups.

Painted characters also lack standardized barcodes and cannot be read by scanners. Operators must verify billet information visually, which increases workload, slows production, and raises the possibility of errors during processing, inventory control, and shipment.
zh: 现场目前采用人工喷涂标记来识别钢坯。在最高 800°C 的高温下，这种方式无法实现连续自动化识别，并带来多项作业问题。
喷涂标记可能随表面氧化皮剥落而消失，导致钢坯在轧制前就丢失标识；冷却后需人工补贴标签，增加了贴错与物料混淆的风险。
喷涂字符没有标准条码、无法被扫码设备读取。操作人员只能目视核对钢坯信息，增加了工作量、拖慢生产，并在加工、库存与出货环节增加出错可能。

en: HEATPROOF HP-700T replaces painted text with standardized barcode identification, giving each billet a unique traceable code.

After the billet leaves the furnace, a robotic system applies the label directly to the hot surface. The heat-activated adhesive provides stable bonding at temperatures up to 800°C, while adhesion continues to increase as the billet cools.
The label is designed to withstand high temperatures, oxidation, and outdoor exposure while maintaining secure attachment and readable identification throughout the process.

HP-700T is also compatible with barcode scanners and machine-vision systems, enabling automated verification without repeated manual checks. Before shipment, each barcode can be scanned and matched against production records to reduce dispatch errors.
zh: HEATPROOF HP-700T 以标准条码标识替代喷涂文字，为每块钢坯赋予唯一可追溯编码。
钢坯出炉后，由机器人系统将标签直接贴附于高温表面。热激活胶粘剂在最高 800°C 下稳定贴合，并随钢坯降温持续增强粘接力。
标签专为耐高温、抗氧化与户外暴露设计，全过程保持牢固贴附与清晰可读。
HP-700T 兼容扫码设备与机器视觉系统，实现自动核验，无需反复人工检查。出货前可扫描每个条码并与生产记录比对，减少发货错误。

en: Reduces incorrect labeling and billet mix-ups.
Enables automated barcode identification and tracking.
Maintains reliable adhesion at temperatures up to 800°C.
Reduces manual inspection and operator error.
Supports end-to-end traceability from production to delivery.
zh: 实现自动条码识别与追踪。
在最高 800°C 下保持可靠粘接。
提升库存与出货准确率。
减少人工检查与操作失误。
支持从生产到交付的端到端追溯。
